info.description: Reusable badge component for section headers

text.description: Badge text displayed above heading (e.g., 'Powered by Industry Leaders', 'Our Mission')

icon.description: Icon for badge. Use emoji (🚀) or Lucide icon name (Rocket, Star, Zap, TrendingUp, Award, CheckCircle, Sparkles, etc.)

variant.description: Badge style variant: default (primary color), secondary (muted), outline (border only), ghost (subtle)

size.description: Badge size: small (compact for nav/articles), medium (default balanced size), large (prominent for hero sections)

animation.description: Enable orbiting light animation around badge border

animationSpeed.description: Animation speed when enabled: extra-slow (10s), slow (5s), medium (3s), fast (1.5s)

orbSize.description: Size of orbiting light dot when animation is enabled

pulse.description: Add gentle pulse animation to badge
